# chatterbox: every wheel uv may install, with its sha256, so
# `uv pip install --require-hashes -r` refuses anything the index serves that
# is not one of these bytes. Resolved 2026-09-24 for Python 3.12 with
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --python-version 3.12
# from chatterbox-tts==0.1.7 and setuptools<81, constrained to the versions
# of a venv that runs the clone daemon (transformers 5.2.0, torch 2.6.0).
# Not `--universal` like the other two: for Python >= 3.14 chatterbox-tts
# 0.1.7 asks for torch >= 2.9, which no lock can reconcile with the 2.6.0
# the daemon runs, so uv finds no solution. The venv is made with
# `--python 3.12` (docs/voice.md), so the minor does not drift here.
